scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cost.notes: College Scorecard (data released 2026-10-15; IPEDS charges for 2025-26, which match the 2025-26 cost tables published by Berea, Pitzer and Scripps): tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance.

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 17,310 applied, 3,030 admitted, 805 enrolled; the residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) add up to the totals. International: 6,955 applied, 303 admitted, 51 enrolled. Test-optional, so the SAT/ACT percentiles describe the 23% (SAT) and 16% (ACT) of enrolled first-years who submitted scores. The GPA bands are the 'all enrolled students' column of C11 (4.0 scale); the average is 3.85. C21 lists 1,342 early decision applications and 477 admitted but labels them 'For the Fall 2024 entering class' (the 2024-25 CDS also lists 477 admitted), so they are not entered here. Undergraduate enrollment (3,065) is the B1 total of all undergraduates; the nonresident count (222) is the B2 'Total Undergraduates' cell for Nonresidents. The PDF is a fillable form: the C7 factor marks and C8 test policy were read from its form-field values, not from rendered text.
